seed 1
compare records
explain _lines=R1
requirement R1 A signature made with the matching private key verifies as `valid`
requirement R2 r or s outside [1, n-1] is `invalid` without needing the point computation (0, and n or larger); and a signature where the recomputed point is itself the point at infinity is `invalid`
requirement R3 Changing r, s or the signed hash by 1 flips a valid signature to `invalid`
requirement R4 A signature checked against a different public key than the one that made it is `invalid`
requirement R5 r == n-1 or s == n-1 (the top of the legal range) verifies `valid` when the signature is otherwise genuine
requirement E2E A mixed batch of signatures: some valid, some altered, some out of range, some wrong key
